customer_content.customer_title: OneNav Classic 9-inch Multimedia Receiver for Toyota 280mm
customer_content.customer_description: A 9-inch touchscreen multimedia receiver for Toyota 280 mm dashboard openings, with 1024 × 600 resolution. It supports wired Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, Bluetooth with an external microphone, and built-in digital sound processing with a multi-band equaliser. The unit is steering-wheel-control ready and provides 4 × 40 W maximum speaker output, 4.1-channel front/rear/subwoofer line outputs, two RCA AV inputs, two video outputs, and front and rear camera inputs.
